criteria.text: Every cloud account in scope is connected and inventoried within the first week, including ones the platform team did not list
criteria.how: Compare the platform's account list with the bill and the identity provider at the end of week one.

criteria.text: The top ten risks the tool reports are confirmed by the customer's own team as real and previously unknown or unprioritised
criteria.how: Review the ten together and mark each confirmed, known already, or wrong.

criteria.text: A critical finding reaches the owning team's ticket queue with an owner and a due date, with no manual copy
criteria.how: Trigger one test finding and follow it to the ticket.

criteria.text: An exposed resource is fixed and the tool shows it closed within a day
criteria.how: Fix one real finding and check when it disappears.

criteria.text: The security lead can answer "what is exposed to the internet right now?" in under five minutes
criteria.how: Ask the question live and time it.
